description.value: The Canadian Brewhouse & Grill is a large, nationally-franchised sports bar and grill located in the Uptown shopping centre area of Victoria. It offers a broad pub menu including daily specials, happy hour, and a kids menu, with online ordering available. Touring cyclists stopping in the Uptown corridor will find a spacious, family-friendly venue open through late evening.
